name: Maine

context: ME critical-area seeding: sand and gravel pits are revegetated by fines content; under about 15 percent fines only warm season grasses give lasting cover.
seeding: ME seeding: dormant seedings are not recommended for mixtures 1 or 2, and only as a last resort for mixture 3.
disturbed: ME critical area: grade pit side slopes to 2:1 or preferably 3:1; at 15 to 20 percent fines tap-rooted perennial legumes also work; above 20 percent cool season grasses.

cover.name: Winter Rye
cover.note: ME 340: Winter rye is drilled at 75 lbs/acre (112 broadcast), 1-2 inches deep; latest seeding Oct. 15.

cover.name: Oats
cover.note: ME 340: Oats are drilled at 75 lbs/acre (112 broadcast), 1-2 inches deep; latest seeding Oct.15.

cover.name: Spring Wheat, Triticale, Barley
cover.note: ME 340: Spring grains are drilled at 75 lbs/acre (100 broadcast); latest seeding Sept 15.

cover.name: Buckwheat
cover.note: ME 340: Buckwheat is drilled at 60 lbs/acre (70 broadcast); latest seeding Sept 15.

cover.name: Hairy Vetch
cover.note: ME 340: Hairy Vetch is drilled at 20 lbs/acre (35 broadcast); latest seeding Aug. 15.

cover.name: Red Clover
cover.note: ME 340: Red Clover is drilled at 10 lbs/acre (12 broadcast); latest seeding Aug. 15.

cover.name: Annual Ryegrass
cover.note: ME 340: Annual Ryegrass is drilled at 20 lbs/acre (30 broadcast); latest seeding Aug. 15.

cover.name: Forage Brassicas (Radish, Turnip, Spring Canola)
cover.note: ME 340: Forage Brassicas are drilled at 10 lbs/acre (15 broadcast); latest seeding Aug. 15.

coverPlant.text: ME 340: Winter rye and oats can be seeded for winter cover up to Oct. 15 (hardiness zones 3b-5a).
ME 340: Oats and spring grains can be seeded for summer cover up to June 1.

seedWin.text: ME seeding: plant as early in spring as possible, shortly after snow is off; cutoff is June 15. Mixture 3 can also go in August 1 to September 15.

gaps: No ME cover crop (340), residue, barrier, windbreak, roughening, grazing or pasture wind-erosion text in the local files (cover crop and residue PDFs are empty scans).
Native species rates are lb/ac PLS from the borrow-pit Mix 1; no MLRA zones given.
